name: Astral uv Open-Source Python Package Manager
free_limit: MIT/Apache-2.0 local Python package and project manager with dependency resolution, lockfiles, Python version management and CLI tool installation; no license fee or per-project quota.
watch_out: This is local MIT/Apache-2.0 software, not a hosted Python development plan. Python packages and registries have independent terms; CI runners, private registries, cloud compute and bandwidth can cost money.
